ios.desc:
Stay in touch with your loved ones abroad at really cheap international rates with the Localphone app.

1 5G READY

–––––––––––––

Get high-definition voice quality with the next generation of mobile Internet. Compatible with the latest 5G (LTE) technology, our app is optimized to be location-aware and will intelligently moderate the quality of your call to ensure you get the best possible connection available to you.

2 SAVE ON INTERNATIONAL CALLS

–––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––---

Use your iPhone to talk to your friends and family in over 250 countries at a fraction of the cost of your mobile provider.

3 TWO CALLING MODES

––––––––––––––––––––---

Use WiFi mode when you have a good Internet connection, or use LOCAL calls mode to dial a normal, local-rate number that connects internationally.

4 FREE CALLS & FREE CREDIT

–––––––––––––––––––––––––––-

All new Localphone customers get a 5 minute free call to try us out. If you don’t already have a Localphone account, just install the app and create an account on our website. Once you have an account, come back to the application and you’ll be able to make a 5-minute free call.

You will also earn free credit every time you share the app with your friends, and there's no limit to how much you can earn.

5 YOU CAN DO ALL THIS

–––––––––––––––––––––---

* Use WiFi mode when you are roaming to save money on expensive calls back home

* View your existing Localphone contacts on your iPhone and make cheap international calls in just one click

* View your call history

* Look-up our worldwide call rates and get a price in seconds

* Check your real-time balance and see exactly how much credit you have

* Call your existing iPhone contacts through the Localphone app and save a fortune

6 OUR RATES

–––––––––––--

Our international call rates are some of the lowest in the world. Now it’s even easier to access them by using this app.

United States from 0.1¢ per min

United Kingdom from 0.6¢ per min

Canada from 0.3¢ per min

Australia from 1.5¢ per min

India from 1.5¢ per min

Pakistan from 3.5¢ per min

Visit www.localphone.com/prices for more countries.

Please note calls made using local numbers may incur charges from your operator, but depending on your call plan these calls may be free as part of your inclusive minutes. When no WiFi signal is found in WiFi mode your data connection will be used. To avoid charges from your operator only use this mode if you have a good WiFi connection or a data allowance.

quotes.text:
but it is most likely not as easy as an app on your smartphone

You mean an app like Google Voice, or one of the many other SIP/VOIP apps out there? I use Localphone as my home SIP provider, and they have an app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/localphone-international-calls/id1328874519

There are tons of ways to make cheap calls from your phone -- when I used to travel internationally a lot, I set up my Android phone dialer with my SIP provider, then I could make and receive calls from the default phone dialer.

But now I don't even bother, I just call home via a video call using Hangouts/Meet or Zoom and use my local SIM to make a local call.
